Usage: memoriahub android keystore [options] [command]

Manage the release signing keystore (~/.memoriahub/android)

Options:
  -h, --help               display help for command

Commands:
  init [options]           Create the release keystore (RSA 4096, valid 100
                           years). Refuses to overwrite.
  import [options] <file>  Use an existing keystore (passwords from
                           ANDROID_KEYSTORE_PASSWORD/ANDROID_KEY_PASSWORD, else
                           a prompt)
  show                     Print the keystore path, alias and certificate
                           SHA-256
  secrets                  Print the four GitHub Actions secrets for CI (#518) —
                           the output CONTAINS SECRETS
  help [command]           display help for command
